title: The Middle Power Moment
key_claim: Middle powers have an important role to play in reviving international cooperation at this dawning moment of a new multipolar world; they can spur pragmatic collective action through narrower minilateral or plurilateral arrangements and cross-regional partnerships.
notes: Structural anchor — canonical reframing of middle-power agency in a multipolar order. Just inside 3-6m structural-anchor band.

title: How middle powers can weather US and Chinese AI dominance
key_claim: Middle powers can pursue four sovereign-AI approaches: specialise in a part of the global AI supply chain, align with one AI superpower, share sovereignty with other countries, or hedge by drawing on capabilities from several countries.
notes: Direct theoretical framing for the corridor signal.

title: Sovereign AI: Building ecosystems for strategic resilience and impact
key_claim: Sovereign AI must be treated as an ecosystem effort connecting energy, compute, data, models, cloud platforms and applications; enterprise interest is widespread but most lack detailed strategy, with sovereign cloud and AI migrations typically taking three to four years.
notes: Anchors enterprise readiness and timeline maturity dimension.

title: The myth of AI sovereignty
key_claim: A small number of economies are pulling ahead in access to advanced chips, reliable power and high-assurance data centres; the US and China alone capture around 65% of aggregate global AI investment; sovereignty should mean strategic agency with options on infrastructure, models and partners, not full independence.
notes: Counter-balancing source: cautions against full-stack sovereignty narrative.

publisher: Press Information Bureau, Government of India (Ministry of Electronics and IT)
title: India to Add 20,000 GPUs Beyond Existing 38,000 to Strengthen National AI Infrastructure (India AI Impact Summit 2026)
key_claim: Government of India to add 20,000 GPUs to the existing 38,000 to strengthen national AI infrastructure; commitment to scaling compute capacity as part of the IndiaAI Mission's sovereign-AI agenda.
notes: Primary government source for India's sovereign-compute scaling commitment.

title: G42 and Government of India Formalize Commercial Framework for Condor Galaxy India AI Supercomputer
key_claim: On Modi's state visit to Abu Dhabi, G42 and Government of India formalized framework and commercial terms for an 8-exaflop Condor Galaxy India AI supercomputer comprising 64 Cerebras CS-3 systems; hosted in India under India-defined governance; G42 partnering with India's C-DAC for installation and operations.
notes: Primary event anchor — vendor PR but the canonical announcement of the deal. Used for factual specifics only.

title: UAE doubles down on US tech and AI ambitions amid Iran war
key_claim: First Nvidia advanced-chip shipment arrived in UAE 8/05/2026; UAE ambassador Yousef Al Otaiba says UAE-US AI partnership is the 'most consequential economic partnership of this decade'; UAE has committed $1.4 trillion for AI infrastructure in the US; Iran war is accelerating rather than slowing sovereign-AI demand.
notes: Quality regional journalism anchor; quotes named officials and gives operational specifics.
